stage_history.notes: Gap-focused discovery (light-to-standard pacing). 4 questions via AskUserQuestion: visual mood (sophisticated data viz), layout strategy (UI Designer proposes 2), animation library (CSS+Recharts, no new deps), theme toggle visibility (always visible in topbar). PRD-002 + prd-minimal-002 written. Originally proposed real+fake premium mix with 2 new API routes (/api/activity, /api/payments) and 3 new SDK surfaces. PM critical review (standard rigor) surfaced 3 BLOCKERs + 5 HIGHs + 10 MEDIUMs. Operator post-review direction: 'stick to what we know; fake premium' — PRD revised to ALL-FAKE premium tier, dropped both new API routes, dropped xmc.authoring.graphql, kept xmc.sites.listSites as the only new SDK call. Net scope shrink ~40%, zero big unknowns. 3 new ADRs (0016 theme toggle visibility, 0017 processed_events tenant_id, 0018 premium fake-data posture).

Architecture 653 lines, all 11 sections. SDK contract gate handled inline for xmc.sites.listSites (Mode A wrapped-options, double .data.data unwrap, Xmapp namespace types, contextId guarded-not-cast, .live policy); Tranche A capture gate added. ADR scan: 0 new ADRs proposed; run stays at 3 (0016-0018). 4 risks captured: R-G processed_events.event_type column may not exist (Tranche A inspection gate added); R-K --primary-foreground token pair safety; R-J ThemeToggle hydration mismatch; SDK shape assumption deferred to Tranche A. No infrastructure delta.

2 UI variants written in parallel (v1 Mosaic Discipline fixed-grid 842 lines; v2 Editorial Cadence asymmetric masonry 766 lines). 2 POC clickdummies generated in parallel (self-contained HTML/CSS/JS, file://-openable, no build). 8 desktop screenshots captured (light+dark x locked+unlocked per variant). Operator iterated on card content: original brief had real events + extension points free cards; revised to user profile + tenant info; premium cards re-themed from generic SEO/Performance to Sitecore-flavored (Publishing activity, Content distribution, Recent edits with site•template references, CMS health KPIs, Sitecore content insights, Content health score). v2 critical bug surfaced + fixed mid-stream: Subscribe banner was a CHILD of .premium-region, inheriting parent's filter:blur(12px) — banner unreadable. Restructured: banner wrapped as SIBLING of .premium-region inside new .premium-section div. **Operator selected v2 (Editorial Cadence).** ADR-0017 (processed_events.tenant_id) NOW DEFERRED since the new free card inventory drops the webhook activity card — schema migration no longer needed in PRD-002. Operator note for future: 'I see in the premium area quite a few values which we can also get easily from Sitecore dynamically. WE should keep this in mind as a nice addon' — captured in PRD-002 § 15 Future Opportunities as PRD-005 candidate.

Lead Developer task breakdown written (803 lines, 41 tasks across 5 tranches A–E). Reconciled drift between PRD/architecture (which still referenced F4=RecentActivity + F5=ExtensionPoints + ADR-0017 schema migration) and the SELECTED v2 POC (F4=UserProfile + F5=TenantInfo + ADR-0017 deferred). Architecture's double-unwrap assumption flagged as Tranche B smoke item — .d.ts suggests single unwrap (`result.data: Sites.Site[]`); component starts single-unwrap with fallback to double if wire shape disagrees. Zero new ADRs needed. Per scope_dial.task_breakdown_review=skip_gate, auto-continuing to QA enrichment without operator confirmation.

operator_attention.item: Runtime contrast assertions are NEW in PRD-002 (T018a, T031a). Tests for F1/F4/F5 + Subscribe banner CTA + premium corner badges use getComputedStyle + contrast helper rather than toHaveClass. JSDOM does not resolve CSS custom properties to color values, so Vitest tests need either jest-axe with the contrast rule OR a small test-utility that resolves Blok Nova preset tokens against a fixture map. May require a brief setup step at T018 implementation. Precedent risk: QuickCopy v0.1 --primary-foreground collapse in dark mode (sitecore:blok-theming pitfall).

`xmc.sites.listSites` envelope ambiguity RESOLVED at T020 Gate B 2026-05-18: DOUBLE-UNWRAP (`result.data?.data` is Sites.Site[]). Single-unwrap implementation crashed at SitesTile render (`state.sites.slice is not a function` because state.sites was the wrapper object, not an array). Fix landed via T013 REFACTOR: sites-tile.tsx now reads `(result.data as { data?: Sites.Site[] } | undefined)?.data ?? []`; fixture defaults flipped; single-unwrap kept as regression sentinel test '8'. 150 tests passing.
